categories.main_business_segments: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China (AMEC) primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end semiconductor equipment including plasma etching equipment, thin film deposition equipment, and MOCVD equipment. The company also develops equipment for integrated circuits, advanced packaging, LED epitaxial production, power devices, MEMS, and other microfabrication applications. Additionally, AMEC is expanding into semiconductor inspection equipment and environmental protection equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced plasma etching technologies (CCP and ICP), thin film deposition technologies including CVD, ALD, LPCVD, and EPI, and MOCVD for compound semiconductor epitaxy. It employs proprietary dual-chamber designs, adjustable electrode spacing, and advanced RF power systems to meet high precision and high aspect ratio etching requirements. AMEC emphasizes autonomous R&D with matrix management of specialized teams and maintains a strong patent portfolio with over 2,900 patent applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AMEC serves leading global semiconductor manufacturers producing integrated circuits, memory chips (DRAM, 3D NAND), power devices (GaN, SiC), LED epitaxial wafers, MEMS, and advanced packaging. Its customers include top-tier chipmakers in China and internationally, with products applied in logic, memory, power electronics, display, and microelectromechanical systems markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with production and R&D bases in Shanghai, Nanchang, Guangzhou, and Chengdu. It also has subsidiaries and sales operations in Singapore, Japan, the United States, and South Korea, serving a global customer base. The majority of revenue is generated from the Chinese mainland market, with growing international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: AMEC operates in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying critical semiconductor fabrication equipment and related services to downstream semiconductor manufacturers. It also invests in key component suppliers to strengthen its supply chain security and localization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-intensity R&D investment, dedicating over 27% of revenue to R&D in 2024, focusing on advanced etching and deposition equipment for sub-5nm logic and high-layer 3D NAND memory. It is expanding into semiconductor inspection equipment and third-generation semiconductor power device equipment (GaN and SiC). AMEC pursues innovation in multi-template etching, ultra-high aspect ratio etching, and advanced MOCVD technologies, while also developing digital industrial internet platforms and environmental solutions.
categories.revenue_model: AMEC generates revenue primarily through the sale of semiconductor fabrication equipment including etching machines, MOCVD systems, and thin film deposition equipment. Additional revenue streams include sales of spare parts, equipment-related services, and technical support. The company employs a direct sales model with some agency sales in Europe.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AMEC is positioned as a leading domestic Chinese semiconductor equipment manufacturer with growing international presence. It competes with established global players from the US, Europe, and Japan, particularly in plasma etching and MOCVD equipment markets. The company holds a strong market share in GaN-based LED MOCVD equipment and is rapidly expanding its footprint in advanced logic and memory etching equipment, with recognized technology and customer validation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, AMEC reported revenue of approximately RMB 9.07 billion, a 44.73% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by a 54.72% growth in etching equipment sales. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 1.62 billion, slightly down due to increased R&D spending. The company’s total assets reached RMB 26.22 billion, growing 21.8% from the previous year, with a strong upward trajectory supported by significant capital investment and expanding production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AMEC emphasizes technological innovation, product differentiation, and intellectual property protection to deliver high-precision, reliable semiconductor fabrication equipment. Its products support advanced chip manufacturing processes including sub-5nm logic and high-layer 3D NAND memory, with unique features like adjustable electrode spacing and dual-chamber designs enhancing process flexibility and efficiency. The company’s proximity to major Asian customers enables superior service responsiveness, and its broad product portfolio across multiple semiconductor segments mitigates market cyclicality risks.
